The '''Mauler Tactical Responder''' was a model of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Based on the [[Republic police gunship/Legends|Republic police gunship]], it was designed to carry two [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] officers in the midst of the conflict.<ref name="Far Horizons" />
